notes.title: And... LIFT OFF! We're Officially Live
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone who followed along on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1U2PkEIkonU]youtube[/url] and/or the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ETp7D7agT5]discord[/url], we are officially all systems go for Rocket Poker!

You can leave feedback, suggestions, bugs and how you beat the game in the community hub discussions.

If you own the Antoni Games Bundle, then you already own Rocket Poker as it was included on release.

Thank you again for playing my games all these years and here's to many more!

[i]Chris[/i]
